stride.S_justification: RF exposure enables spoofed telemetry frames.
stride.T_justification: Tampering possible on encrypted RF link.
stride.I_justification: Sensor data leakage risk if crypto fails.
stride.D_justification: Jamming or flooding can deny service.
stride.E_justification: Elevation limited by encryption but possible via key compromise.

threats.name: Telemetry spoofing and jamming on downlink
threats.description: Adversary spoofs or jams RF telemetry frames to mislead operators or deny service.

mitigations_technical.title: RF frame authentication and sequencing
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce per-frame MAC and monotonic sequence numbers on all downlink telemetry frames.

mitigations_technical.title: Adaptive anti-jam waveform selection
mitigations_technical.description: Implement frequency hopping and spread-spectrum techniques with automatic fallback under detected jamming.

mitigations_administrative.title: Downlink monitoring and anomaly response policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Define operator procedures for telemetry loss or anomaly detection including alternate comms activation.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed commands critical for flight safety.

threats.name: Command spoofing and replay on uplink
threats.description: Adversary spoofs or replays authenticated commands to seize flight control.

mitigations_technical.title: Challenge-response command authentication
mitigations_technical.description: Require fresh nonces and signed challenges for every uplink command set.

mitigations_technical.title: Replay protection via timestamp windows
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce strict time-bounded validity for all command tokens and nonces.

mitigations_administrative.title: Uplink command authorization policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require dual-operator confirmation for safety-critical commands and maintain signed audit logs.

stride.S_justification: Spoofing mitigated by TLS but boundary exposed.
stride.T_justification: Data tampering possible on network segment.
stride.I_justification: Sensor frames may leak ISR data.

threats.name: Spoofed sensor data injection
threats.description: Adversary injects falsified sensor frames at the ground boundary.

mitigations_technical.title: TLS mutual authentication and certificate pinning
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce client certificate validation and pin trusted certificates for all HTTPS endpoints.

mitigations_administrative.title: Sensor data source validation policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require cryptographic signing of all sensor frames and periodic source attestation audits.

threats.name: Tasking spoof and waypoint tampering
threats.description: Adversary spoofs tasking to redirect strikes or sensor coverage.

mitigations_technical.title: Signed tasking packages with hash chaining
mitigations_technical.description: Require digital signatures and hash-linked task updates for all retasking operations.

mitigations_administrative.title: Tasking approval and dual-control policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce two-person approval workflow for any waypoint or payload changes.

threats.name: Spoofed BIT command injection
threats.description: Adversary spoofs maintenance commands to mask faults or trigger unsafe states.

mitigations_technical.title: 1553 bus message authentication extension
mitigations_technical.description: Add cryptographic MAC to 1553 messages using pre-shared maintenance keys.

mitigations_administrative.title: Maintenance port access control policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require physical and logical authentication tokens for all maintenance bus access.

threats.name: HUMS log tampering
threats.description: Adversary tampers with health logs to conceal prior damage or faults.

mitigations_technical.title: Signed and timestamped HUMS records
mitigations_technical.description: Require cryptographic signatures on all HUMS downloads before storage.

mitigations_administrative.title: HUMS integrity audit policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Mandate post-download integrity verification and retention of signed logs for 90 days.

threats.name: Malicious software load injection
threats.description: Adversary injects unauthenticated or tampered software packages via maintenance port.

mitigations_technical.title: Hardware-enforced load signing verification
mitigations_technical.description: Require hardware root-of-trust verification of package signatures before any write to flash.

mitigations_administrative.title: Software load authorization and chain-of-custody policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce signed release notes and two-person verification for every software load.

threats.name: Signed package tampering on LAN
threats.description: Adversary tampers with signed packages to introduce malicious code.

mitigations_technical.title: LAN segment isolation and integrity gateway
mitigations_technical.description: Route all software packages through an authenticated integrity gateway with mandatory signature validation.

mitigations_administrative.title: Package distribution change control policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require change board approval and cryptographic signing of every baseline manifest update.

threats.name: Key material spoofing and disclosure
threats.description: Adversary spoofs or exfiltrates key material to decrypt satellite links.

mitigations_technical.title: Hardware security module key wrapping
mitigations_technical.description: Wrap and unwrap all keys inside FIPS-validated HSM before transmission or storage.

mitigations_administrative.title: Key rotation and escrow policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce automated quarterly key rotation with offline escrow and immediate revocation capability.

threats.description: Adversary injects falsified intelligence to misdirect mission planning.

mitigations_technical.description: Require signed and attested intelligence summaries from all external feeds.

mitigations_administrative.title: Intelligence source vetting policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Maintain approved source list and require periodic re-validation of all intel providers.

threats.name: Mission plan tampering
threats.description: Adversary tampers with mission plans to alter targeting or routes.

mitigations_technical.title: End-to-end plan signing and verification
mitigations_technical.description: Sign every mission plan at creation and verify signature at every relay hop.

mitigations_administrative.title: Plan change control board policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require formal change board approval and cryptographic attestation for any plan modification.

threats.description: Adversary spoofs or tampers with approved mission packages to redirect weapons.

mitigations_technical.title: Multi-party package approval with threshold signatures
mitigations_technical.description: Require threshold signatures from at least two independent approvers before package execution.

mitigations_administrative.title: Weapon release authorization policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Mandate positive visual confirmation and two-person control for any weapon release package.

mitigations_technical.description: Sign all status messages and validate monotonic sequence numbers at the broker.

mitigations_administrative.title: Status anomaly escalation policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Define escalation procedures for status sequence failures or signature mismatches.

threats.name: GCS command spoofing
threats.description: Adversary spoofs operator commands to seize aircraft control.

mitigations_technical.title: Mutual TLS with operator certificate pinning
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce mutual TLS and pin operator certificates for all GCS sessions.

mitigations_administrative.title: GCS operator credential policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require hardware tokens and session timeouts for all GCS operators.

threats.name: Spoofed mission package relay
threats.description: Adversary spoofs relayed mission packages to alter execution.

mitigations_technical.title: Package relay signature verification
mitigations_technical.description: Validate end-to-end signatures at receipt before accepting any mission package.

mitigations_administrative.title: Relay integrity monitoring policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Log and alert on any signature verification failure at the relay boundary.

threats.name: Weaponized mission package spoof
threats.description: Adversary spoofs mission packages to redirect weapons or sensors.

mitigations_technical.title: Threshold-signed weapon packages
mitigations_technical.description: Require threshold signatures from planning authority and broker before execution.

mitigations_administrative.title: Weapon package release board policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require formal release board approval for any package containing weapon profiles.

threats.name: Spoofed execution status feedback
threats.description: Adversary spoofs status to conceal weapon employment or progress.

mitigations_technical.title: Signed status telemetry with monotonic counters
mitigations_technical.description: Sign every status frame and validate counters at the relay.

mitigations_administrative.title: Status integrity alert policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Define real-time alerts and operator response for status signature failures.

threats.name: Spoofed intel feed injection
threats.description: Adversary injects falsified intelligence to misdirect routing.

mitigations_technical.title: Feed source certificate pinning
mitigations_technical.description: Pin trusted certificates for all intelligence ingest endpoints.

mitigations_administrative.title: Intel source accreditation policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Maintain formal accreditation list and periodic re-validation of intel sources.

threats.name: Mission plan tampering
threats.description: Adversary tampers with plans to alter routes or targeting.

mitigations_technical.title: Plan integrity gateway at broker
mitigations_technical.description: Validate plan signatures at the route broker before forwarding.

mitigations_administrative.title: Plan change approval policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require documented approval for any plan modification before broker acceptance.

interfaces.name: Key Distribution Interface
interfaces.description: Carries keying material from the Key Management Authority to the Key Distribution Module

threats.name: Key material spoofing
threats.description: Adversary spoofs or exfiltrates key material to break encryption.

mitigations_technical.title: HSM-protected key transport
mitigations_technical.description: Transport all keys inside HSM-protected envelopes with mutual authentication.

mitigations_administrative.title: Key authority access control policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Restrict key authority access to cleared personnel with two-person rule.

mitigations_administrative.title: Intel source accreditation and monitoring policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Maintain and audit accredited source list with periodic re-validation.

mitigations_technical.description: Validate plan signatures at broker ingress before any processing.

mitigations_administrative.title: Broker change control policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require formal approval and logging of any plan modification at the broker.

threats.name: Spoofed intel feed injection
threats.description: Adversary injects falsified intelligence to mislead planning.

mitigations_technical.title: TLS client certificate pinning for intel feeds
mitigations_technical.description: Pin certificates for all intelligence ingest connections.

mitigations_administrative.title: Intel feed accreditation policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Maintain and periodically audit list of accredited intelligence sources.

mitigations_administrative.title: Broker relay audit policy

mitigations_technical.description: Add MAC to all 1553 BIT commands using maintenance session keys.
